_readme: Real completed dryer vent jobs. Each entry renders a project card on /projects.html and the three most recent on the homepage. Photos go in /images/projects/ . Leave the array empty and both sections fall back to generic copy instead of showing placeholders.

_fields.slug: url-safe id, used for the anchor link
_fields.title: e.g. Severe Dryer Vent Blockage
_fields.issue: short label, e.g. Severe lint blockage
_fields.result: outcome; include the airflow figures only if they were actually measured
